## What it is

Boîtier alimentation, cavité 50 × 87,6 mm, murs et fond 1,6 mm, 40 mm de haut. Origine = coin intérieur bas-gauche ; l'extérieur commence à −1,6 ; −1,6. Ouverture 5 mm calée à droite dans le mur Y min (X = 45 → 50), seuil 25 mm au-dessus du fond. Ouverture 5 mm dans le mur X min : Y = 0 → 5, même seuil. Ouverture 5 mm dans le mur X min, Y = 81,0 → 86,0 (1,6 mm sous Y max) pour que la face nord reste continue jusqu'au coin ouest. Berceau PSU 21,8 × 27,8 × 35 mm en haut à droite : réglette 2 mm dont le flanc droit est à X = 28,2 (50 − 21,8), Y = 42,2 → 70 ; muret nord de l'alim à Y = 70, largeur X = 21,8 mm seulement, 35 mm de haut ; 17,6 mm de cavité au-delà (16 mm mur à mur). Muret batterie (sud de l'alim) à Y = 42,2, 32,5 mm de haut. Berceau Wago 221-415 : 19,0 mm de vide face à face sous ce muret (flanc nord du muret bas à Y = 21,6), deux rails Y de 15 mm écartés de 5 mm des parois ouest et est, réglette sud 15 mm (affleurant la plateforme), muret vertical 32,5 mm dont le flanc droit est à X = 20,2 (50 − 29,8), retour 1 mm côté berceau sur 8 mm au nord seulement (insertion en biais par le sud). Trois puits d'aimant Ø8,2 (peau 0,6 mm) : centre du berceau Wago, (10, 30) et (10, 60). Logement nord : deux 221-423 sur la tranche, sorties ouest, 18,6 mm en X, 16 mm mur à mur, volume Z 19,8 mm au-dessus de la plateforme 15 mm ; deux rails X de 15 mm collés à la face est, 5 mm des faces Y ; muret ouest 15 mm (affleurant la plateforme) ; un seul surplomb 1 mm / 45° sur le mur nord, 8 mm depuis l'est, à 15 + 19,8 mm au-dessus du fond. Deux heat inserts Ø4 × 5 mm, corbeau 45° depuis le mur (pas de tour depuis le fond) : ouest à Y = 60 (puits nord), sud collé à l'ouverture (bord est à X = 40). Un pont anti-tirage par ouverture : face sud à 10 mm de l'ouest, face est à 10 mm du sud, face nord à 10 mm de l'ouest.

## Design notes

Printed floor on the bed. Inner origin (0, 0). Outer 53.2 × 90.8 × 40 mm. Inner 50 × 87.6. PSU volume is alim_x × alim_y × alim_z = 21.8 × 27.8 × 35 mm, X = 28.2 → 50, Y = 42.2 → 70. The X = 28.2 face is the right edge of a 1.6 mm réglette, not its centre. PSU north wall: south face at Y = 70, thickness toward +Y, only alim_x wide (plus overlap into the east outer wall), alim_z = 35 mm above the floor. Extra 17.6 mm of cavity north of Y = 70 (the 1.6 mm wall sits in that, leaving 16 mm wall-to-wall). Battery / Wago-stop wall: north face at Y = 42.2, 32.5 mm tall like the vertical Wago wall, thickness 1.6 mm toward −Y (south face at 40.6). Clear Y gap 19.0 mm face-to-face, so the lower 15 mm wall has its north face at 21.6 (south at 20.0). Two 15 mm Y-rails under the Wago, 1.6 mm thick, 5 mm off the west wall (X = 20.2) and the east inner wall (X = 50), so those walls can flex; the 15 mm south wall is flush with the rails (no 1 mm lip). Wago width 29.8 mm from inner X max (221-415 30 mm with −0.2 press-fit, same as wagox5): right face of the vertical wall at X = 20.2. The 16 mm south réglette and that wall meet as a full-thickness L (outer corner X = 18.6, Y = 20.0), not a T. 1 mm lip toward +X, 45° lead-in, only 8 mm along Y at the north of the wall (exposed Y = 32.6 → 40.6); the south of the bay stays open so the terminals tilt in. Three standing Ø8.2 magnet wells (puit_debout, 0.6 mm bed skin, 1.6 mm pad around the bore): Wago bay centre at (35.1, 31.1), plus (10, 30) and (10, 60) from the inner SW origin. North bay: two 221-423 on edge, outputs west, X = 18.6 (wago_profondeur), Y = 16 wall-to-wall (two 8.0 mm bodies), Z = 19.8 above the 15 mm platform (18.8 mm body + 1 mm under the catch). Two 15 mm X-rails fused into the east wall, 5 mm off the north wall and the PSU wall (same `wago_plateforme_z` / `wago_rail_ecart` as the south bay). West muret 15 mm (flush with the platform) running in Y, east face at X = 31.4. One 1 mm / 45° lip on the outer north wall only, 8 mm from inner X max (`wago_surplomb_longueur`), at floor + 15 + 19.8. The PSU-wall lip is gone so the terminals tilt in from the west. Cable openings start 25 mm above the floor (Z = 26.6 from the bed), not at the 15 mm platform. Three openings: south 5 mm flush right (X = 45 → 50); west 5 mm at Y = 0 → 5; west 5 mm at Y = 81.0 → 86.0 (1.6 mm south of inner Y max), so the north wall meets the west wall. 0.6 mm chamfer on the jambs and sills of all three (inner and outer); 1 mm would collide across the 1.6 mm wall. Two M-style heat-insert bays, Ø4 × 5 mm, 1.6 mm wall: 45° corbel from the inner face starting 10.6 mm below the rim (5.6 mm of 45° then 5 mm of pad). Pad 5.6 × 7.2 mm. Bore flush with the inner face so the 1.6 mm wall is the outer insert wall. West bay centred on puit_y_nord (Y = 60). South bay east edge at X = 40 (10 mm from inner X max; the south opening is now 5 mm, X = 45 → 50). One cable-tie U per opening, 10 mm from the corner: inner south (X = 10), inner east (Y = 10), inner north (X = 10). Each has 1.3 mm side walls, a 3 × 1.2 mm gap, 5 mm tall, 5.6 mm overall. Open top and bottom so the tie comes out vertically; 45° legs above and below with the 3 mm centre open. 0.4 mm chamfer on the two inner edges under each bar (where the tie runs). Sits at the opening sill (Z = 26.6 → 31.6 for the U, ramps 23.8 → 34.4). Polish 1 mm on the four outer vertical corners.

## Don't

- Do not treat 50 × 70 as inner: inner is 50 × 87.6. Outer is 53.2 × 90.8.
- Do not treat 50 × 70 as outer: they were inner before the north extension.
- Do not centre the PSU réglette on X = 28.2: the right face is at 28.2 (50 − 21.8).
- Do not put the 5 mm south opening off Y min: it is flush right, X = 45 → 50, not the old 10 mm (X = 40 → 50).
- Do not treat Y = 42.2 or X = 28.2 as muret centres: 42.2 is the north face of the battery wall. The 19.0 mm is the clear gap, not centre-to-centre.
- Do not put the Y gap back to 19.8 mm or 20 mm: 19.0 mm is the intended face-to-face.
- Do not put PSU Y back to 28 mm: 27.8 mm is the intended pocket (south face at 42.2, north at 70).
- Do not put the PSU X pocket back to 28 mm (réglette at 22): it is 21.8 mm, right face at 28.2.
- Do not leave the Y = 42.2 wall at 17.5 mm, nor drop either Wago wall back to 17 or 17.5 from the floor: both are 32.5 mm (17.5 above the 15 mm rails) so the lip sits 0.5 mm above two stacked 8.4 mm terminals.
- Do not fill the Wago bay with a solid 15 mm block: two Y-rails, 5 mm off the west and east walls so those walls can flex; do not glue the rails back to the side walls.
- Do not put the front Wago lip back to 16 mm unless asked: it is 15 mm, flush with the platform, so the terminals come out. The 1 mm catch on the tall walls stays.
- Do not join the 15 mm south réglette to the west Wago wall with only the 0.4 mm boolean overlap: they are a full-thickness L, each running to the other's outer face, so the outer corner is one edge (and takes the 1 mm polish).
- Do not take 29.8 mm from inner Y. It is 50 − 29.8 along X, and that coordinate is the right face.
- Do not go back to 28.8 mm of Wago width: the 221-415 needs 29.8 mm (30 − 0.2).
- Do not model the 1 mm Wago lip as a square shelf: 45° underneath, same catch as wagox5.
- Do not run the Z lip the full length of the Y-wall: only 8 mm at the north, so the Wagos can tilt in.
- Do not flush the north-west opening with Y max, nor cut through the north wall: it is 5 mm, Y = 81.0 → 86.0 (1.6 mm south of inner Y max), so the north face runs to the west corner. Not 10 mm (Y = 76 → 86).
- Do not chamfer the opening lips 1 mm: the wall is 1.6 mm, so inner and outer 1 mm collide. 0.6 mm on jambs and sills.
- Do not skip the opening chamfers: the sharp lips cut cable sheaths.
- Do not run the cable openings down to the floor or to the 15 mm platform: all three start at 25 mm above the floor (Z = 26.6 from the bed).
- Do not run the PSU north wall the full inner X: only alim_x (21.8 mm), east-aligned.
- Do not flush the PSU with the new inner Y max: the 17.6 mm surplus is north of Y = 70 (16 mm clear).
- Do not put inner Y back to 86.8 / surplus 16.8: that was 15.2 mm wall-to-wall. The north Wagos need 16 mm.
- Do not add a lid unless asked.
- Do not drop the magnet wells: three Ø8.2 standing wells, 0.6 mm skin, at the Wago bay centre (35.1, 31.1) and at (10, 30) and (10, 60) from the inner SW origin.
- Do not put the west wells back to X = 15: the Ø8.2 bore nicked the Wago wall. They sit at X = 10.
- Do not run the north-bay lip the full inner X: only 8 mm from the east, same `wago_surplomb_longueur` as the south bay.
- Do not put the PSU-wall lip back on the north bay: one catch on the outer north wall is enough; the terminals tilt in from the west.
- Do not glue the north X-rails to the north wall or the PSU wall: 5 mm off, same `wago_rail_ecart` as the south bay.
- Do not measure `nord_wago_z` from the floor: it is 19.8 mm above the 15 mm platform (18.8 mm body + 1 mm). The catch sits at floor + 15 + 19.8.
- Do not drop the north catch back to 18.8 mm above the platform: the extra millimetre is so it clears the 221-423.
- Do not take `nord_wago_x` from the 221-415 width: it is 18.6 mm (221-423 depth, outputs west).
- Do not run the cable openings down to the floor: they start at 25 mm above the floor, not at the 15 mm Wago platform.
- Do not model the lid inserts as towers from the floor: 45° corbels from the west and south inner faces.
- Do not put the west insert off Y = 60: it matches puit_y_nord, not the south well.
- Do not put the south insert's east edge anywhere but X = 40 (10 mm from the east). It is not tied to the 5 mm opening.
- Do not model those lips as square shelves: 1 mm catch, 45° underneath, same as the 221-415.
- Do not put the anti-tirage on the outer face, nor skip one: south at X = 10, east at Y = 10, north at X = 10, one per opening.
- Do not open the anti-tirage sides: the 1.3 mm walls stay. The tie exits vertically through the open top (same 3 mm as the bottom), not sideways.
- Do not let the lower anti-tirage subtract eat the wall: stop at the inner face. Extra margin in +Y (north) or +X (east) nicks the face.
- Do not drop the 1.2 mm gap to 1 mm: the tie is 1 mm thick.
